name: Jac
caption: You've been conditioned to chase more. What if the goal was to need less?

slides.text:
What if everything you were taught about success was backwards?

What if the goal was never to HAVE more,

but to NEED less?

They taught you
• success = a bigger house
• success = a bigger title
• success = a bigger number

But nobody taught you how to feel at peace in the life you already have.

That's why so many people “make it” and still feel empty.

Maybe real success looks like

waking up without an alarm,
owning your time,
and not needing anyone's applause to feel enough.

Stop chasing more.
Start chasing FREE.
